# Visual Brand Designer

## About Us
WOGOM is a B2B Commerce and Retail Enablement Platform, empowering 6,000+ retailers and 450+ sellers across India with better Products, Pricing, Credit, and Growth Opportunities. Our goal is to build a connected ecosystem where technology, capital, and commerce converge to help Indian retailers scale with confidence.

## Role Overview
The Visual Brand Designer will play a key role in developing compelling brand identities and designing marketing materials for social media and websites. This role will have a direct impact on WOGOM's mission by creating a strong visual brand presence that resonates with our target audience. The ideal candidate will bring a creative and strategic approach to visual brand design, with a passion for developing brand guidelines and visual identity.

## Key Responsibilities
• Design marketing materials for social media and websites to drive business results and engage our target audience.
• Develop brand guidelines and visual identity, ensuring consistency across all marketing channels, and collaborate with cross-functional teams to drive business results.
• Manage design projects, prioritize tasks, meet deadlines, and collaborate with teams to deliver high-quality design work.
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to drive business results and ensure alignment with company goals.
• Develop a design system and style guide to ensure consistency across all marketing channels.

## Requirements
### Must-Have Skills
• Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator) and Figma/Sketch for UI/UX design.
• A strong portfolio of design work demonstrating expertise in visual brand design.
• Excellent communication and project management skills.

### Nice-to-Have Skills
• Experience with front-end development principles and agile design methodologies.
• Knowledge of design trends and industry developments.

## Who Will Succeed in This Role
The ideal candidate will be a creative and strategic thinker with a passion for design and a keen eye for detail. They will thrive in a fast-paced environment with excellent communication and project management skills.

## Success Metrics
• Develop a comprehensive understanding of the company's brand guidelines and visual identity within the first 30 days.
• Design and launch a successful marketing campaign within the first 90 days.
• Establish a strong brand identity that resonates with the target audience within the first 6 months.

## How to Apply
To apply for this role, please submit your resume and a portfolio of your design work to our website. We look forward to hearing from you and exploring how you can contribute to our team.
